Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_CapMinutes_toolt: How long each account may spend connected per week, in real minutes. The week runs from Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 in the server's timezone. 600 is ten hours.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_ExemptRoles_tool: Semicolon-separated role names. Accounts holding one of these are never counted and never turned away, so an operator can always get in. Leave empty to limit everybody.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_GraceSeconds_too: How long a player who has run out of time is given to read the notice before their game disconnects itself. They can dismiss it to leave sooner.
